name: Supply Chain Delivery Performance Dashboard
description: Performed data cleaning and preprocessing using Python (Pandas, NumPy).
Automated data preparation and maintained logs for traceability.
Developed KPIs such as delay rate, total orders, and model accuracy using DAX.
Built a machine learning model to predict delivery delays.
Created interactive dashboards with charts, heatmaps, and insights.

name: HR Dashboard Analytics
description: Identified department-wise attrition concentration indicating operational and management challenges.
Observed higher attrition among mid-tenure employees, highlighting gaps in career growth and retention strategies.
Analyzed salary distribution and found higher attrition in lower salary bands, suggesting compensation-related issues.
Detected hiring vs attrition trends showing recruitment spikes followed by increased turnover.
Evaluated workforce demographics including age and gender to assess diversity and long-term sustainability.
Enabled interactive analysis using filters and drill-downs for dynamic HR decision-making.

name: Sales Dashboard
description: Designed sales performance dashboard with key KPIs.
Analyzed regional and product-wise sales trends.
Enabled data-driven business decisions through visualization.

name: Note Making Web App
description: Built a responsive note-taking application using React JS.
Users can create, edit, delete, and organize notes efficiently.
Added search and pin functionality for better productivity.
Used React Hooks for smooth state management.

name: Expense Tracker
description: Tracks income and expenses in real time.
Provides summary dashboard of spending patterns.
Clean and user-friendly UI for financial tracking.
